roleDescription.inspector: Inspectors capture inspections in the field, review measurements, and adjust grades when needed. Admin-only actions (variety editing, model installation, hyperparameter tuning) are read-only here.
roleDescription.admin: Admins manage varieties, model installation, and hyperparameter tuning. Inspectors and admins share the same field capture workflow.

recordings.title: Recordings
recordings.empty: No recordings yet. Hold the shutter on Capture to record.
recordings.deleteConfirm: Delete this recording? This cannot be undone.
recordings.permissionDeniedBody: Allow Photos access in Settings to save recordings.
recordings.pendingDiscardBody: It will be removed from the sync queue. The captured video stays on the device.
